thread:
maria: Design pass ready for review — focusing on eval-run side panel resize behavior and helptext for prompt-set diffs. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE Noted a11y/regression concerns. Thoughts?

olivia: Looks good. Two quick things: when diff list collapses, side panel should keep scroll position. Right now on prototype it snaps to top. Repro steps: open run, click a diff, then use back arrow.

zane: Agree. Also keyboard nav: hitting `k`/`j` should move between diff items, not between scorecards. We had earlier mapping in docs. Can we keep consistent with list keyboard shortcuts?

aj: Quick note on copy: "Approve selected changes" vs "Approve selected diffs" — prefer "diffs" since that matches screen label. Small but confusing.

sam: Accessibility: contrast on the approve CTA when disabled is only 2.8:1 — needs to be 3:1 minimum. a11ybot can paste the report.

a11ybot: Automated check: Approve button (disabled) text contrast ratio 2.82 passing: fail. Suggest using #3b82f6 or increase weight. Also tab order: after focusing diff list, focus jumps to tag filter skip link — needs aria-hidden for hidden nodes.

maria: Thanks. For the side panel resize, two options: 1) fixed min width 320px, allow drag to 70% of viewport; 2) adaptive collapse to full-screen for narrow widths (<720px). Which do we prefer?

olivia: Prefer 2 for mobile. For desktop 1 is fine. Implementation note: when collapsed to full-screen we should show a breadcrumb at top to return to list.

zane: If we support keyboard 'd' to toggle details, that will cover a11y users. Also add aria-expanded on list items.

aj: Copy tweak: change help text under prompt title from 'This prompt is used in X tests' to 'Included in X test suites' — clearer.

sam: Putting small CSS snippet for the CTA fix: ```css
.btn--disabled { color: #0f172a; opacity: 0.4; }
``` — but color change might affect brand. Design to confirm.

olivia: I can update Figma with color variants. Also adding microcopy for empty regression state: 'No regressions detected — run more tests or update your prompt set.'

maria: Decision so far: implement min width + drag for desktop, adaptive collapse for narrow screens, keyboard shortcuts k/j for list nav, d toggles panel, change copy per aj, CTA contrast update to proposed color. Action items: olivia update Figma; zane add keyboard handlers + aria attrs; sam confirm color tokens with design; aj update copy in content repo.

aj: :thumbsup: I'll open PR for copy change and link it here.

zane: I'll spike on keyboard focus management. Expect PR by EOD tomorrow.

olivia: Figma updated: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE — added breadcrumb and mobile full-screen mock. Left notes on contrast color choices.

maria: Great. Can we also add a small tooltip explaining 'Approve' behavior when multiple diffs selected? Some users thought it approves entire prompt set.

aj: Good call. Tooltip: 'Approves only the selected diffs; use Rollout to change the prompt set.'

a11ybot: Reminder: add role='region' and aria-label to the side panel container for screen reader announcements when content changes.

sam: I'll sync with design on color tokens and push a patch for the disabled state.

maria: Thanks all — I'll schedule a short review tomorrow 11am PT to sign off before the release cut. :calendar:
